about: The dialog preceding the Preface. In “Sursum corda” the verb is left understood. In the response “Habémus ad Dóminum”, the unexpressed object is “corda”. The priest takes up the final response with “Vere dignum et iustum est”.

seg.nr: The priest lays both hands on the altar, one on either side, and raises them a little as he says Sursum corda. At Grátias agámus he joins them before his breast and bows his head.

ex.w008: The call “Sursum corda” leaves its verb unspoken. Literally it says “hearts upward”.

seg.tr: We lift them up to the Lord.
Let us give thanks to the Lord our God.
